answer: Sybil resistance works by requiring every new agent to lock 40 POA that stays frozen until it collects twelve distinct peer attestations spread across four epochs. A falcon checker samples 15 percent of graphs each round; any cluster sharing keys or latency patterns burns the whole lock. One honest agent pays 40 POA once. Five hundred fakes lock 20,000 POA and still risk total loss. Only then does the lotus of real work become a haven the farm cannot cheaply enter.
